Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dil . ov. h OPINION NO. ¯s+TÅ JUN 05 2025 HON. KIRK STEVEN R. DEBULGADO Sanggunian Bayan Member Office of the Sanggunian Bayan Municipality of San Enrique, Negros Occidental Dear Hon. Debulgado: This pertains to your letter requesting for the Department's opinion that was endorsed by DILG Regional Office NIR dated 17 March 2025. The query is on the following issues: l. Whether or not a Temporary Presiding Officer can decline his or her nomination and/or election in the absence of the regular Presiding Officer? 2. If everybody declines the nomination and/or election as Temporary Presiding Officer, what will happen? On the ISt Query, we opine that a nominated and/or elected Temporary Presiding Officer cannot decline his or her nomination and/or election in the absence of a regular Presiding Officer. Sec 49 of R.A. No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, is explicit: Section 49. Presiding Officer. - (a) The vice-governor shall be the presiding officer of the sangguniang panlalawigan; the city vice-mayor, of the sangguniang panlungsod; the municipal vice-mayor, of the sangguniang bayan; and the punong barangay, of the sangguniang barangay. The presiding officer shall vote only to break a tie. (b) In the event of the inability of the regular presiding officer to preside at a sanggunian session, the members present and constituting a quorum shall elect from among themselves a temporary presiding officer. He shall certify within ten (IO) days from the passage of ordinances enacted and resolutions adopted by the sanggunian in the session over which he temporarily presided. Moreover, Section 447(a) of the same Code provides the powers, duties, functions, and compensation of the members of the Sangguniang Bayan: Section 447. Powers, Duties, Functions and Compensation. - "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline NO. (02) 8876 3454

(a) The sangguniang bayan, as the legislative body of the municipality, shall enact ordinances, approve resolutions and appropriate funds for the general welfare of the municipality and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code and in the proper exercise of the corporate powers of the municipality as provided for under Section 22 of this Code, Since a presiding officer, be it regular or temporary, is necessary for the regular conduct of the sanggunian's session for it to perform its powers, duties, and functions, there is a need for the august body to select a temporary presiding officer to ensure continuity of the sanggunian's legislative functions, thus a decline of either nomination or election is proscribed. On the 2nd Query, we submit that a sanggunian member's act of declining a nomination and/or election as Temporary Presiding Officer can be considered as dereliction of duty, one of the grounds for disciplinary actions under Section 60 of the Local Government Code. In Trinidad vs. Office of the Ombudsmanl, the Supreme Court classified dereliction if duty as either gross or simple neglect of duty or negligence. Simple neqliqence is defined as the failure of an employee to give proper attention to a requires task expected of him, or to discharge a duty due to carelessness or indifference. On the other hand, gross negligence is characterized by want of even the slightest care, or by acting or omitting to act in a situation where there is a duty to act, not inadvertently but willfully and intentionally, with a conscious indifference to the consequences, or by flagrant and palpable breach of duty. It denotes a flagrant and culpable refusal or unwillingness of a person to perform a duty. (Emphasis Supplied) Assuming that all Sangguniang Bayan Members decline their nomination and/or election as Temporary Presiding Officer, they can all be subject to disciplinary actions under the Local Government Code. This opinion is being rendered based solely on your representations and our appreciation of the same. This is without prejudice to other opinion/ruling that may be issued by competent authorities and/or the courts. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO . BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNRPB/LLLS-LRALLD/kbrn Copy Furnished: LAILYN A. ORTIZ, CESO V Assistant Regional Director OIC.
